quickStart.title: Quick Start (3 Steps)
quickStart.step1: Open Dynamo in Revit: Go to Manage tab → Visual Programming → Dynamo
quickStart.step2: Create Python Script Node: Search for "Python Script" and drag it onto the canvas
quickStart.step3: Paste & Run: Double-click the node, paste the entire generated script, and run it!

whatGetsCreated.title: What Gets Created
whatGetsCreated.walls: Walls: All wall segments with correct dimensions and thickness
whatGetsCreated.doors: Doors: Automatically placed on nearest walls
whatGetsCreated.rooms: Rooms: Created at polygon centers with labels

features.title: Features
features.dualCoords: Dual Coordinates: Both pixels (original) and millimeters (real-world)
features.autoScaling: Auto-scaling: Calculates mm-per-pixel from dimension text
features.autoFamily: Auto family selection: Uses first available wall/door/window families
features.errorHandling: Error handling: Continues processing even if individual elements fail

instructions.tip: Tip: The JSON path is hardcoded in the Python script, so you can run it directly without connecting input nodes!

howItWorks.title: How it works:
howItWorks.step2: AI detects walls, doors, windows, and rooms using Google Gemini vision
howItWorks.step3: Coordinates are converted to millimeters using auto-calculated scale
howItWorks.step4: Revit JSON is generated with dual coordinates (pixels + mm)
howItWorks.step5: Dynamo Python script is auto-generated for easy import
howItWorks.step6: Open the script in Revit/Dynamo to create all elements!
